parameters.description: How many pages each output file gets, when splitting every N pages. 1 makes a PDF per page.
parameters.name: fixed_range

parameters.description: Required when removing pages: which pages to delete. The first page is 1, so '1,4,8-12' drops those pages and keeps the rest.
